en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large timber building with steep gabled roofs on a wooded hillside beside a reservoir or river. In front of the building is a terrace with many parasol-covered tables crowded with people. Below the slope, excursion boats full of passengers travel along the water. The scene is framed like a typical vintage tourist postcard. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Zschopau-Talsperre Kriebstein.
